_comment: Example watchlist seed. Copy this file to data/watchlist.local.json and edit to add your target companies. The local copy is gitignored. db.py reads watchlist.local.json first; if missing, falls back to this example. Schema: company (display name), ats_type (greenhouse | ashby | lever | workable | workday | smartrecruiters | custom), ats_slug (board id used in the ATS API URL — e.g. 'anthropic' for boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic), enabled (1 to fetch in scheduled runs, 0 to track-but-skip), linkedin_company_id (numeric LinkedIn company ID — leave null if you only fetch via career-page ATS).
